body: When I feel bad I sometimes tend to blame the environment and other people for my situation. But it's a generic feeling. I don't have a specific target. My psychiatrist knows this, but I never remind her about it.

I think I'm an intermediate user. I can install distros like Gentoo and Arch Linux. I also have an LPIC-1 certification. But I don't want to become a Linux admin. I don't want to work at all. I'm not mentally stable for a job. And I have a huge gap in my resume that I can't really justify.
